$comment: Example backends for the smart-router extension. The recommended setup uses pi's built-in 'opencode-go' provider (auth via OPENCODE_API_KEY, 'pi auth opencode-go', or '/login opencode-go'). Copy this into ~/.pi/agent/models.json (global) or <project>/.pi/models.json only if you need to override model defaults - configure your own model IDs to match the routes in pi-smart-router.json.
